management_remarks: TCS concluded FY26 with record Revenue of Rs 2,58,000 Crore, EBIT of Rs 63,200 Crore (24.5% margin), and Net Profit of Rs 49,200 Crore. Full-year TCV bookings exceeded USD 41 billion, providing multi-year revenue visibility as enterprise AI transitions from pilot proof-of-concepts to large-scale deployment. Our cash and marketable securities reached Rs 48,500 Crore with ROE at 51.0%, underscoring the durability of TCS's cash-compounding business model.
analyst_qa: Looking ahead to FY27, while our TCV backlog is at a record high, enterprise IT budget releases remain cautious and subject to uncertain global GDP and geopolitical headwinds. Legacy application maintenance pricing remains challenging as GenAI productivity benchmarks become standard in renewal negotiations. We will maintain a calibrated cost structure as quarterly deal ramp-ups can remain volatile and moderating in macro-sensitive verticals.
